note: Adapted from Chhotani (1997), entry 198 (p. 324); all three castes (alate, soldier and worker) are present in the original, synonyms and references are omitted, and the distribution is not included in the entry.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to brown, sometimes paler posteriorly; antennae and labrum brown; pronotum cream white; legs and abdomen cream white. Head and body sparsely pilose. Body length 5.50–7.20. Head capsule nearly rectangular, about twice as long as wide, sides slightly constricted in front of the antennae (length to mandible base 2.30–2.50, width 1.30–1.45). Anterior part of the frons slightly inclined; coronal suture almost reaching the fontanelle. Fontanelle small, situated at 4/5 of the head length; length from the posterior margin of the head to the fontanelle 1.95–2.10. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segments 2 and 4, segment 4 the shortest. Labrum asymmetrical, nearly square, anterior margin slightly incurved, anterolateral corners with short horn-like projections (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.25–0.30). Mandibles asymmetrical: left mandible strongly twisted, length 1.43–1.70; right mandible blade-like, curved outward near the apex (length 1.37–1.50). Postmentum elongate and rod-like, slightly constricted at the waist (length 1.40–1.50, maximum width 0.40–0.50, waist width 0.25). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.33–0.40, width 0.80–0.88), anterior margin weakly concave in the middle, posterior margin convex without a notch.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale straw yellow; antennae, pronotum and legs cream white; abdomen greyish due to intestinal contents. Head sparsely pilose, body pilosity moderate. Body length 3.2–4.0. Head capsule nearly circular (length to mandible base 0.85–0.90, maximum width 0.95–1.05). Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and longer than segment 4, segment 4 the shortest. Postclypeus inflated, half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.40–0.55), anterior margin rounded without a notch, posterior margin convex without a notch.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown; postclypeus, labrum, antennae and legs golden yellow; pronotum yellowish brown, darker posteriorly; wings brown; ventral surface dark brown, pale yellow beneath. Head and body densely covered with fine short hairs and some long hairs; wing membrane with a few short hairs near the apex. Body length with wings 14.10–15.10, without wings 7.40–8.00. Head capsule nearly circular (length to mandible base 0.90–1.00, width including the eyes 1.27–1.38); slightly depressed around the fontanelle; a white linear spot in front of the fontanelle. Fontanelle plate large, oval (length 0.08–0.12, width 0.05). Eyes round, strongly protruding, maximum diameter 0.35–0.40. Ocelli oval, length 0.17–0.20, width 0.10–0.13, distance from the eye 0.05–0.07. Postclypeus inflated and pilose, length 0.20, width 0.57. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 the shortest. Pronotum flat, only slightly raised anteriorly, length 0.61–0.68, width 1.03–1.15; anterior margin weakly concave in the middle, posterior margin strongly emarginate. Forewing length 12.7–13.2, hindwing length 12.0.
